frontmatter.title: AIChilles: Automatically Uncovering Hidden Weaknesses in AI-Evolved Systems
frontmatter.author: Lesley(Yajie) Zhou, Ao Li, Ashwin Silla, Zaoxing Liu, Vyas Sekar
frontmatter.excerpt: AIChilles is an agentic weakness-finding tool that treats the human-written program as a differential oracle for an AI-evolved program, searching for valid workloads where the evolved program regresses. Across 5 systems and 30 AI-evolved programs, AIChilles finds 49 hidden weaknesses.
